citations.quote: We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto not caused by collision, minus the comprehensive deductible shown in the Declarations. Loss caused by the following is considered other than collision: ... theft or larceny; ...

For theft of your covered auto, you must report the theft to the police within 48 hours of discovering it. We will pay for loss only after 30 days have passed without recovery of the vehicle, unless the vehicle is recovered earlier in damaged condition.

output.reasoning: The claim involves the theft of the entire vehicle, which falls under 'Other than collision' (comprehensive) coverage as defined in COMP-1. The claimant reported the theft to the police immediately, satisfying the reporting requirement in COMP-3. There are no applicable exclusions (such as commercial use, racing, or intentional damage) based on the facts provided.
